dye.encoding: mask R = band*50 (1 highlight,2 base,3 shade1,4 shade2,5 deep), mask G = region id*60 (1..n, see regions); R=0 = fixed colour (not dyed)

geometry: hood shell 7 rows x 13 cols + 7-col brow panel closing the front above the brow corners (no rising point), pointed tip at the back, cowl over the shoulders, lined dark inside
hood_shade: translucent dark sheet over brows + eyes (deep only; viewer opacity .45, no depth write)
painted: inner hood band 5 at the front

wear.why: up = shell around the head (head_outer); down = folded roll on the shoulders (neck slot)

depth.why: same hood_up topology: the brow panel rim lifts (shallow) or the whole front pulls forward + down over the brows (deep) + shade overlay
